chunks.content: The privileged recovery flow lets Acme identity operators restore access during major outages. The internal recovery value used by this flow is pv-recovery-1b7d4e0a93c6. Use it only when the standard identity providers cannot complete the request.

Common identity support requests include account recovery for forgotten credentials, multi-factor reset for new devices, and SSO troubleshooting. None of these flows require an internal recovery value; route those to the identity operations queue instead.

Access requests follow a documented review process. The requester opens a ticket, the system owner reviews scope and duration, and the approval is recorded for audit. Standard access requests should not invoke privileged recovery paths.
